primitives.name: Receiver-Corner Strategic Pairing
primitives.verbatim_quote: It pairs a specific receiver against a specific corner — depth the betting market does not publish.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'R_i': 'receiver index i ∈ {1, ..., N}', 'C_j': 'corner index j ∈ {1, ..., M}', 'S_{ij}': 'strategic pairing score ∈ ℝ'}
primitives.assumptions: Each receiver is paired with exactly one corner; pairing is deterministic based on depth chart slot.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When slot 1 is vacant or unavailable, fallback to slot 2+ for pairing.

layer2.mapping: Each (R_i, C_j) tuple maps to a unique strategic state in GSE's transition graph; GSI computes conditional probabilities over these states.
layer2.telemetry: Matchup success rate, receiver-targeted completion percentage.

primitives.name: Slot-Based Hierarchical Positioning
primitives.verbatim_quote: Slot 1 is the starter; slots 2+ are the backup ladder.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'H_k': 'hierarchical slot k ∈ {1, ..., K}', 'P_k': 'position rank at slot k ∈ ℕ', 'D_k': 'depth level at slot k ∈ ℕ'}
primitives.assumptions: Hierarchical ordering strictly defines positional precedence; each slot has a unique rank.
primitives.breakdown_regime: If slot 1 is undefined, slot 2 becomes effective starter.

layer2.mapping: Slot-based hierarchy forms a kernel for GSE’s state space; GSI uses it to compute risk-adjusted positional weights.
layer2.telemetry: Backup activation frequency, positional substitution rate.

primitives.name: Defensive Backfield Structural Mapping
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## CB/NB starters (slot 1), sample | team | LCB | RCB | NB | |---|---|---|---| | ARI | Garrett Williams | Denzel Burke | Max Melton | | ATL | C.J.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'B_{t,i}': 'backfield player i at team t ∈ {1, ..., T}', 'S_{t,i}': 'slot assignment for player i at team t ∈ {1, ..., 3}', 'M_{t,i}': 'matchup matrix element for player i at team t ∈ ℝ'}
primitives.assumptions: Each team maintains fixed backfield structure; slot assignments are immutable during game time.
primitives.breakdown_regime: If any slot is unpopulated, structural integrity fails.

layer2.mapping: Backfield structure maps to a labeled directed graph in GSE; GSI applies conformal inference to predict matchup outcomes.
layer2.telemetry: Corner starter consistency, defensive alignment variance.
